messages:
lucas: hey team, lucas here, joining as product analytics. i'm stuck completing SSO. okta kept redirecting to an error after i clicked 'Activate Okta Verify' — page shows 'Activation failed: invalid_request'. anyone seen this?
it-bot: Created IT ticket IT-2043 for @lucas. If urgent, run `/pager tanya`.
tanya: welcome @lucas! what device/os are you using, and did you open the link in a private tab? sometimes browser extensions block the flow.
lucas: macbook pro macOS 13 and iPhone 13 Pro. tried in chrome normal mode and safari, same result.
tanya: thanks. two quick workarounds: 1) use Manual Setup ("Can't scan?" -> copy secret) and add it to 1Password as a TOTP; or 2) use the Okta Verify app on a different device. i'll reset your factors from admin console if neither works.
ben: welcome lucas! FYI we require 1Password OTP for repo access initially, so make sure you accept the org invite. check spam.
lucas: i haven't received the 1Password invite yet. checked spam.
tanya: sent invite re-sent. also i reset your MFA factors — try signing in now and choose Manual Setup.
it-bot: IT-2043 updated: MFA reset by tanya. ETA 20m.
lucas: used manual setup + added OTP to 1Password after re-sent invite. sign-in succeeded and email is provisioned. thanks all!
ben: great — i'll add you to analytics-squad GH team in a bit. ping if anything else blocks you.
lucas: will do, thanks :thumbsup:
